EmailTemplate.subject: Is your payment experience an asset or liability?
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
How Is Your Payment Experience? Hi, ‌
Destination management companies have been slow to adapt to modern digital payment technologies, partly due to the complexity of their legacy systems, and the assumption that payments are not an integral part of the customer experience. For modern day travelers, this way of thinking can create friction and confusion putting off potential clients and agents, and deterring them from future bookings with that DMC. ‌
Check out this recent blog and discover four things DMCs can learn from others that have made payments an integral part of the client/agent experience.
